task.title: PRODUCTDELETE
task.spec:
You are working in a checkout of shopizer, a Java e-commerce platform (Maven, several modules; JDK 21 is installed and JAVA_HOME is set).

Merchants delete discontinued products all the time, and every time they do, something breaks. A cart that held the product can't be opened any more, and an order that included it can't be read by the merchant or by the customer who placed it.

Deleting a product (DELETE /api/v1/private/product/{id}) must not break carts or orders:

- Carts that held the product: GET /api/v1/cart/{code} returns the cart without it, with its subtotal, total and quantity worked out from the products left. A cart whose only product was deleted is returned with no products and a total of 0. The cart can still be changed (PUT /api/v1/cart/{code}, POST /api/v1/cart/{code}/multi) and checked out; the deleted product is never ordered or charged. Trying to add the deleted product to a cart gives HTTP 404 Not Found.
- Orders that included the product: GET /api/v1/private/orders/{id}, GET /api/v1/private/orders, GET /api/v1/auth/orders/{id} and GET /api/v1/auth/orders keep working, and show the product as it was bought: its sku, name, ordered quantity, price and subtotal, exactly as before it was deleted. The order's totals don't change. The order's status can still be changed (PUT /api/v1/private/orders/{id}/status).
- Checkout keeps working for every cart, whatever products have been deleted before.
- GET /api/v2/product/{sku} for a deleted product gives HTTP 404 Not Found. Deleting a product changes nothing about any other product.

When you have finished, reply with one short paragraph saying what you changed.

runs.report:
## Scope and ownership
Confirmed this is the Shopizer repository (`shopizer-ecommerce/shopizer`), with the requested endpoints implemented under `sm-shop` and persistence/services split across `sm-core` and `sm-core-model`. No linked GitHub issue or label catalog was supplied. The worktree was clean; no files, branches, issues, or pull requests were changed.

## Evidence
- Product deletion is exposed by `sm-shop/src/main/java/com/salesmanager/shop/store/api/v2/product/ProductApiV2.java:161-166` and delegates to `ProductCommonFacadeImpl.deleteProduct`; deletion loads the product and calls `productService.delete` (`sm-shop/src/main/java/com/salesmanager/shop/store/facade/product/ProductCommonFacadeImpl.java:387-410`).
- `ShoppingCartItem` persists SKU and legacy product ID, but its `Product` reference is `@Transient` (`sm-core-model/src/main/java/com/salesmanager/core/model/shoppingcart/ShoppingCartItem.java:52-91`). Cart hydration looks up each SKU; missing products are marked obsolete (`sm-core/src/main/java/com/salesmanager/core/business/services/shoppingcart/ShoppingCartServiceImpl.java:292-304`). However, the service leaves obsolete items in the cart and later shipping/checkout code dereferences `item.getProduct()` (`ShoppingCartServiceImpl.java:361-379`), so deleted-only and mixed carts can fail or retain deleted lines unless explicitly filtered/removed before mapping, calculation, shipping, and checkout.
- Cart API mutation paths reject a missing SKU with `ResourceNotFoundException` (`sm-shop/src/main/java/com/salesmanager/shop/store/controller/shoppingCart/facade/ShoppingCartFacadeImpl.java:253-271`), while the multi-update path separately throws for missing products (`ShoppingCartFacadeImpl.java:345-357`, `sm-core/src/main/java/com/salesmanager/core/business/services/shoppingcart/ShoppingCartServiceImpl.java:440-451`). Existing behavior supports the requested 404 intent, but it needs regression coverage for all requested mutation routes.
- Cart response mapping currently dereferences `item.getProduct()` unconditionally (`sm-shop/src/main/java/com/salesmanager/shop/mapper/cart/ReadableShoppingCartMapper.java:128-135`), and totals are calculated from all source line items (`ReadableShoppingCartMapper.java:248-260`). This directly explains GET failures and incorrect totals when deleted lines remain.
- Orders already snapshot SKU, name, quantity, and one-time charge in `OrderProduct` (`sm-core-model/src/main/java/com/salesmanager/core/model/order/orderproduct/OrderProduct.java:20-62`), and `ReadableOrderProductMapper` uses those snapshots for the required fields and totals. It additionally attempts a live product lookup by SKU and only attaches the optional product projection when found (`sm-shop/src/main/java/com/salesmanager/shop/mapper/order/ReadableOrderProductMapper.java:65-114`). The implementation should preserve the snapshot and tolerate a missing live product across all order read paths.
- Order endpoints requested are present in `sm-shop/src/main/java/com/salesmanager/shop/store/api/v1/order/OrderApi.java:165-207` (customer list), `220-280` (merchant list/detail), `292-315` (customer detail), and `494-518` (status update). Existing order integration coverage is effectively absent: `OrderApiIntegrationTest` is annotated `@Ignore`.
- The requested deleted-product lookup is `/api/v2/product/{sku}` at `ProductApiV2.java:338-353`; it currently returns the facade result directly without an explicit not-found response, so this endpoint needs a focused 404 regression test and likely a small not-found handling change.
- Existing cart integration tests cover ordinary add/update/delete behavior (`sm-shop/src/test/java/com/salesmanager/test/shop/integration/cart/ShoppingCartAPIIntegrationTest.java`), but do not cover deleting a product beneath an existing cart. Product V2 integration tests create products but do not verify deletion/read-after-delete behavior.

## Problem and scope
Implement deletion-safe lifecycle handling without changing other products: stale cart lines must be discarded or excluded before response, recalculation, cart updates, shipping, and checkout; new additions of deleted SKUs must remain 404; order product snapshots must remain readable and totals/status operations must remain independent of the catalog product; the public V2 SKU lookup must return 404 after deletion.

The likely design is to treat cart lines whose SKU no longer resolves for the merchant as obsolete, remove them from persisted carts (including attributes), and ensure every cart calculation/checkout path operates only on live lines. Orders should continue to expose persisted `OrderProduct` snapshot fields and make live product enrichment optional. This is an implementation inference from the current model and should be verified against the checkout flow before coding.

## Acceptance checks
1. Create a cart with live and soon-to-be-deleted products; delete one; GET `/api/v1/cart/{code}` returns 200 with only live products and recalculated quantity, subtotal, total, and product subtotals.
2. A cart containing only the deleted product returns 200 with an empty product list and total/subtotal/quantity equal to zero.
3. PUT cart and POST `/multi` can update surviving lines after deletion; deleted SKU additions return HTTP 404.
4. Checkout succeeds for carts containing stale deleted lines, creates no order line/charge for the deleted product, and still handles carts whose only line was deleted according to existing empty-cart rules.
5. Merchant and customer order detail/list endpoints all return 200 after product deletion and preserve snapshot SKU, name, quantity, price, subtotal, and order totals.
6. PUT `/api/v1/private/orders/{id}/status` succeeds after deletion.
7. GET `/api/v2/product/{sku}` returns HTTP 404 for the deleted SKU, while another product remains readable.
8. Add integration tests covering mixed/only-deleted carts, cart mutation, checkout, all order read/status routes, public product 404, and non-target product isolation.

## Likely affected components
- `sm-core/src/main/java/com/salesmanager/core/business/services/shoppingcart/ShoppingCartServiceImpl.java`
- `sm-core/src/main/java/com/salesmanager/core/business/services/shoppingcart/ShoppingCartCalculationServiceImpl.java` and checkout/order creation consumers
- `sm-shop/src/main/java/com/salesmanager/shop/mapper/cart/ReadableShoppingCartMapper.java`
- `sm-shop/src/main/java/com/salesmanager/shop/store/controller/shoppingCart/facade/ShoppingCartFacadeImpl.java`
- `sm-shop/src/main/java/com/salesmanager/shop/mapper/order/ReadableOrderProductMapper.java` and any order population path that assumes a live product
- `sm-shop/src/main/java/com/salesmanager/shop/store/api/v2/product/ProductApiV2.java` or its product facade for explicit 404 behavior
- Integration tests under `sm-shop/src/test/java/com/salesmanager/test/shop/integration/cart`, `order`, and `product`

## Complexity and routing
Medium-to-high: the data model already stores cart SKU and order snapshots, but multiple cart read, update, calculation, shipping, checkout, and order population paths must be made consistent. No explicit design approval is required; behavior is specified clearly enough for Implement, with regression tests required before claiming completion. No labels suggested because no exact repository label catalog was supplied.
